feeds.title: Bluegrass Today
feeds.description: Your independent source of bluegrass news. Follow the latest news on all of your favorite bluegrass artists from yesterday to today. View the concert calendar & read album reviews. Discover something new today!

feeds.title: Ted Lehmann's Bluegrass, Books, and Brainstorms
feeds.description: Welcome to my Blog. I write primarily about bluegrass music and the bluegrass experience. I also review books I read as well as offering road notes and travel entries. Come in and look around to see whether there's anything here for you.

feeds.title: AustralianBluegrass.com
feeds.description: This site aims to keep Australian Bluegrass fans in touch with what's happening in the bluegrass music scene globally but more importantly what's going on around Australia. Contributions may be made by anyone from anywhere.

feeds.title: Bluegrass Heritage Foundation
feeds.description: Bluegrass Heritage Foundation's mission is to preserve and promote bluegrass music in America. The Foundation seeks to educate the public about this distinctly American form of music with roots in Irish, Scottish, and English traditional music through educational programs and workshops, public performances of bluegrass music, historic preservation efforts, and other similar programs.

feeds.title: Matt Flinner Blog
feeds.description: Multi-instrumentalist Matt Flinner has made a career out of playing acoustic music in new ways. He is recognized as one of the premier mandolinists as well as one of the finest new acoustic/roots music composers today. He has toured and recorded with a wide variety of bluegrass, new acoustic, classical and jazz artists.

feeds.title: Fervor Coulee Bluegrass Blog
feeds.description: I'm Fervor. I have been a root and bluegrass music writer for twenty years, having also hosted bluegrass radio and presented concerts. I currently write for Country Standard Time and Exclaim! while maintaining a blog.

feeds.title: The IBMA Foundation
feeds.description: The IBMA Foundation was created by the International Bluegrass Music Association in 2007 with a bequest from the Richard Barnhart estate. Our mission is to build a brighter future for bluegrass music. We help donors create a bluegrass legacy by supporting programs and projects that focus on bluegrass music-related arts and culture, education, literary work and historic preservation.

feeds.title: The High 48s
feeds.description: Since forming in northeast Minneapolis in 2006, The High 48s have been making music that combines the soulful sound of classic bluegrass with a modern attitude. They're a band with one foot in tradition and the other in the world of music today. The High 48s are passionate about music education and in demand as instructors, teaching one-on-one, online, and in workshops.

feeds.title: Knee-deep In Bluegrass
feeds.description: For more than thirty years, Cindy has pursued her passion for Bluegrass Music as an award-winning broadcaster, producer, promoter, singer, musician, writer, photographer, and MC. Cindy uses her knowledge of music and enthusiasm to entertain and educate.

feeds.title: Bluegrass Music Association of Maine
feeds.description: The Bluegrass Music Association of Maine is a non-profit organization dedicated to supporting bluegrass music in Maine. BMAM is an organization of listeners and players, who enjoy Bluegrass music. This webpage is maintained to help get the word out about shows, festivals, public invited jams, workshops, and all things bluegrass that are of interest to our members and guests.

feeds.title: Southeast Michigan Bluegrass Music Association
feeds.description: The Southeast Michigan Bluegrass Music Association is a nonprofit organization. We are a network of individuals working to ensure the future and preserve the memories of bluegrass music in Southeast Michigan.

feeds.title: Ondra Kozák
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ondra Kozák. Since 2004 I've been regularly teaching at several bluegrass workshops in Europe. Besides playing and teaching music, I also work in my studio as an engineer and producer, making recordings of my projects or doing the studio work for other musicians, bands, choirs, etc. If you feel interested in my activities, check out my blog.

feeds.title: Austin Scelzo Blog
feeds.description: Hi- I'm Austin Scelzo, and I am passionate about education, empowering others, and inspiring a lifelong love of music in people of all ages. I aim to draw the best out of my students and love to coach them in whatever direction they might desire. I have taught all ages, instruments ranging from strings to brass, and am an active musician as a singer and fiddle player in the Bluegrass groups the Rock Hearts, On the Trail and the Angry O'Hara's in addition to freelance playing.

feeds.title: The Bluegrass Ireland Blog
feeds.description: The source for news of bluegrass and old-time music events in Ireland and more authored by Richard Hawkins. Richard Hawkins is also the member of IBMA, IBMM, and BBMA.

feeds.title: Fretmentor's Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Fretmentor Blog. A place for students, performers or simply those who enjoy learning about their banjo, guitar and mandolin instruments.

feeds.title: The Bluegrass Shack
feeds.description: The Bluegrass Shack is a music store in Southern Illinois dedicated to acoustic music. This blog describes the town, store activities, bluegrass music in general, instrument repair, and my own personal opinions about all things bluegrass.

feeds.title: The European Bluegrass Blog
feeds.description: The European Bluegrass Blog is for sharing news and other information among everyone concerned with bluegrass music in Europe.

feeds.title: Talkin' Bluegrass Music
feeds.description: The picture of the Bluegrass Shack, Lucy, TN, is significant in my life. I first heard bluegrass music from the Tennessee Gentlemen right there in 1980. Life changed from that moment.

feeds.title: Greg Schochet Blog
feeds.description: Greg Schochet is a full-time performer, teacher, and producer in Boulder, Colorado. Equally adept on guitar and mandolin, he is fluent in all manner of acoustic and electric styles, specializing in bluegrass, swing and country. Greg is an integral part of Colorado's thriving roots music scene and is a sought after instructor, session player, producer and collaborator.

feeds.title: Rock Hearts
feeds.description: Formed in 2013, Rock Hearts brings together five veteran musician from southern new England who loves to sing and pick bluegrass, old country tunes, and seek out newer tunes from other genres to bluegrass. The group consists of Joe Deetz, Alex MacLeod, Billy 'BT' Thibodeau, Austin Scelzo, and Rick Brodsky.

feeds.title: The Bluegrass Jamboree Blog
feeds.description: The Bluegrass Jamboree is an online radio broadcast station. Our personalities span the U.S. and beyond. We are streaming the best mix of Bluegrass, Bluegrass Gospel & Traditional Country music radio all day, every day since 2013.

feeds.title: Branded Bluegrass Blog
feeds.description: Home page of Branded Bluegrass, a bluegrass group from Kokomo, IN.. Branded Bluegrass is a very talented and highly entertaining group that is known as a crowd pleaser! They are rooted in traditional bluegrass but are willing to venture out and tack.

feeds.title: The Oly Mountain Boys Blog
feeds.description: The Oly Mountain Boys are a South Puget Sound bluegrass institution, picking and singing around Olympia, Washington since 2008. They bring a Pacific Northwest sensibility to the bluegrass sound through traditional tunes and original compositions and showcase the power of the American bluegrass music tradition.

feeds.title: Bluegrass Pride
feeds.description: Our mission is to recruit, encourage, and support LGBTQ+ bluegrassers of all levels, promoting their advancement and acceptance within all areas of the bluegrass music industry and musical community. We aim to uplift the genre of bluegrass as a whole to receive LGBTQ+ folks openly, and to promote allyship with all marginalized peoples within the industry and musical community.

feeds.title: Bluegrass Country
feeds.description: Bluegrass Country Radio is a listener-supported online and 88.5 HD-2 public radio station dedicated to enlightening a worldwide audience about the history of bluegrass music, and supporting the future of bluegrass culture.

feeds.title: Grass Clippings Piles of Americana & Bluegrass News, Reviews And Festivals
feeds.description: Grass clippings is a soup of everything from the world of americana and bluegrass music, including music reviews, news clips, artist profiles and more. Grass clippings is a blog by Garland Harwood, Stef Smith and some other folks.

feeds.title: Bluegrass Unlimited
feeds.description: Bluegrass Unlimited Magazine was founded in 1966 by a group of Washington, DC area bluegrass musicians and fans. Now Bluegrass Unlimited is a print magazine that has been dedicated to the furtherance of bluegrass music for over 50 years. You can read about various artists, bands, new music, and more.

feeds.title: Wilson Pickins Blog
feeds.description: Promoting Bluegrass and Roots Music, Festivals, Venues and Bands. Committed to representing first-class, professional entertainment for your stage, station & music collection, backed by integrity.
